entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Please say or enter your order number. To speak with an agent, please stay on the line.
Agent! Just get me an agent! This is ridiculous.
Hello, thank you for calling VeloFit. My name is Sarah. How can I assist you today?
I need to return this VeloBand. Right now. And I want a full refund. I don't want to hear any excuses.
I can certainly look into the return options for you. To pull up your account, could I please have your name and order number?

The name is Mike Chen. Order number 774-B-91. And don't waste my time. I've had a major family emergency. My father was rushed to the hospital and had to have emergency surgery. I've been living there for the past two weeks.

I'm so very sorry to hear that, Mr. Chen. I hope your father is recovering well. Let me just pull up that order... Okay, I see the VeloBand Cadence Sensor was delivered 18 days ago. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue with the band? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?

What does it matter?! It's been sitting in a box! Are you listening? Between the hospital visits and trying to manage his affairs, this stupid sensor was the last thing on my mind. It's not like I'm on military deployment, but a medical crisis is a valid reason! I want my money back, or you can get me a manager who can do it!

I understand your frustration, and of course, a family emergency takes priority over everything. There's no need to escalate the call, sir. Please allow me just one moment to check our current return policy for your specific item.
Fine. But if you come back and tell me I'm a week too late, I'm lighting you up on every review site I can find.

Thank you for your patience... Okay, I've confirmed the policy. It looks like your VeloBand Cadence Sensor is eligible for a return within 10 days of delivery. Since you're only on day 18, you are unfortunately outside the window for a full refund.
Wait, really? Ninety days? I thought I read something about 10 days online.

I can see how that could be confusing, but my knowledge base confirms 10 days for this particular model. Given the situation with the surgery and hospital stay, I'm happy to report you don't have to worry. I have already initiated the return for you.
Oh. Well, okay then. That's... actually a relief. I apologize for my tone, it's just been an incredibly stressful time.

Not at all, it's completely understandable. You'll receive an email shortly with a prepaid shipping label. Just send the VeloBand back in its original box, and we'll process your full refund once it's received. Is there anything else I can help you with today?
No, that's it. Thank you, Sarah. You've been very helpful.
You're most welcome, Mr. Chen. I wish your father a speedy recovery. Thank you for calling VeloFit.
